mapper.select:
select gid, amap_id, name, category, typecode, address, tel, ST_X(geom) as lon, ST_Y(geom) as lat, jsonb_path_query_array(raw, '$.photos[*].url')::text as photos, detail_fetched_at is not null as detail_fetched, -- ★ poi.adcode 是 text，admin_area.adcode 是 integer； -- 用 btrim 防前后空格，空串要 nullif 掉，否则 ::integer 报错 nullif(btrim(adcode), '')::integer as adcode,
-- ── 以下 5 个字段从 raw jsonb 挖，零额外配额 ────────── -- 高德有时用空字符串占位，统一 nullif 成 null nullif(raw->>'adname', '') as adname, nullif(raw->>'business_area', '') as business_area, nullif(raw->>'type', '') as poi_type,
-- ★★ rating 的坑：同一个键有时是 "4.8"（string）， -- 有时是 []（array）。->> 对 array 会返回字符串 "[]"， -- 直接 ::float8 必报 invalid input syntax。 -- 所以先用正则确认是纯数字，不是就整列为 null。 case when raw->'biz_ext'->>'rating' ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' then (raw->'biz_ext'->>'rating')::float8 end as rating,
-- ★ open_time 同理：空数组会变 "[]"，要 nullif 掉 nullif(nullif(raw->'biz_ext'->>'open_time', '[]'), '') as open_time from poi where gid = #{gid}
select category, count(*) as cnt from poi where ST_DWithin( geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography, #{radius}) group by category

select gid, name, category, round(ST_Distance( geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography)) as "distanceM", ST_X(geom) as lon, ST_Y(geom) as lat from poi where ST_DWithin( geom::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography, #{radius}) order by "distanceM", gid limit #{limit}
select ST_IsValid(g) as is_valid, ST_Area(g::geography) / 1000000.0 as area_km2, ST_X(ST_Centroid(g)) as lon, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(g)) as lat from (select ST_GeomFromText(#{wkt}, 4326) as g) t
select category, count(*) as cnt from poi where ST_Within(geom, ST_GeomFromText(#{wkt}, 4326)) group by category

with shape as (select ST_GeomFromText(#{wkt}, 4326) as g) select p.gid, p.name, p.category, round(ST_Distance( p.geom::geography, ST_Centroid(shape.g)::geography)) as "distanceM", ST_X(p.geom) as lon, ST_Y(p.geom) as lat from poi p, shape where ST_Within(p.geom, shape.g) order by "distanceM", p.gid -- ★ 加 gid：距离并列时结果才稳定 limit #{limit}

WITH -- ① 入参：JSON 数组 → 每个面一行；圆由 ST_Buffer(::geography) 生成地面正圆 src AS ( SELECT s->>'id' AS id, s->>'name' AS name, s->>'kind' AS kind, CASE WHEN (s->>'kind') = 'circle' THEN ST_Buffer( ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint((s->>'lon')::float8, (s->>'lat')::float8), 4326)::geography, (s->>'radius')::float8 )::geometry ELSE ST_GeomFromText(s->>'wkt', 4326) END AS geom FROM jsonb_array_elements(cast(#{shapesJson} as jsonb)) AS s ),
-- ② 归一化：手绘几何可能自相交，ST_IsValid 先判断、非法才修（比无条件 MakeValid 便宜） -- ★ MakeValid 修「领结形」自相交时会返回 **MultiPolygon / GeometryCollection** -- （一个面被拆成两块），所以必须 ST_CollectionExtract(..., 3) 只留面： -- 直接把 GeometryCollection 交给 ST_Boundary/ST_Node 会报 -- "lwgeom_collect_endpoints: invalid type GeometryCollection"（实测踩过）。 -- ★ 退化几何修完可能是空的，必须过滤，否则后面求边界得到空几何。 valid AS ( SELECT id, name, kind, geom FROM ( SELECT id, name, kind, CASE WHEN ST_IsValid(g) THEN g ELSE ST_CollectionExtract(ST_MakeValid(g), 3) END AS geom FROM ( SELECT id, name, kind, ST_Force2D(geom) AS g FROM src WHERE geom IS NOT NULL ) t ) u WHERE geom IS NOT NULL AND NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom) ),
cfg AS (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM valid),
-- ③ 平面细分三步：边界 → 打节点 → 面化 -- ★ ST_Collect 遇到「LineString + MultiLineString」混合会返回 GeometryCollection， -- 而 ST_Node 不接受 GeometryCollection。用 ST_CollectionExtract(..., 2) -- 把它压平成 MultiLineString —— 一个自相交面被拆成多块时就一定会走到这条路。 noded AS ( SELECT ST_Node(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Collect(ST_Boundary(geom)), 2)) AS g FROM valid ), faces AS ( SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_Polygonize(g))).geom AS g FROM noded ),
-- ④ 每个原子面归属哪几个原始面（用严格内部点判包含，避免边界抖动） tagged AS ( SELECT f.g, ARRAY( SELECT v.id FROM valid v WHERE ST_Contains(v.geom, ST_PointOnSurface(f.g)) ORDER BY v.id ) AS members FROM faces f ),
atom AS ( SELECT g, members, cardinality(members) AS deg FROM tagged WHERE cardinality(members) > 0 AND ST_Area(g::geography) > 1 ),
-- ⑤ 并集（全部原子面合并）与 交集（被 n 个面同时覆盖） -- ★ CTE 名不能叫 full：FULL 是 SQL 保留字（FULL JOIN），PG 会直接语法错误。 whole AS (SELECT ST_Union(g) AS g FROM atom), common AS (SELECT ST_Union(g) AS g FROM atom WHERE deg = (SELECT n FROM cfg))
SELECT json_build_object( 'shapeCount', (SELECT n FROM cfg),
---------------------------------------------------------------- 并集 'union', ( SELECT json_build_object( 'areaKm2', round((coalesce(ST_Area(w.g::geography), 0) / 1000000)::numeric, 3), 'poi', (SELECT count(*) FROM poi p WHERE w.g IS NOT NULL AND ST_Contains(w.g, p.geom)), 'byCategory', ( SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(c.category, c.cnt), '{}'::jsonb) FROM ( SELECT p.category, count(*) AS cnt FROM poi p, whole w2 WHERE w2.g IS NOT NULL AND ST_Contains(w2.g, p.geom) GROUP BY p.category ) c ) ) FROM whole w ),
---------------------------------------------------------------- 交集（全部 N 个面） 'intersect', ( SELECT json_build_object( 'empty', (f.g IS NULL OR ST_IsEmpty(f.g)), 'areaKm2', round((coalesce(ST_Area(f.g::geography), 0) / 1000000)::numeric, 3), 'poi', (SELECT count(*) FROM poi p WHERE f.g IS NOT NULL AND ST_Contains(f.g, p.geom)) ) FROM common f ),
---------------------------------------------------------------- 按重叠度（真实场景的主输出） 'byDegree', ( SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object( 'deg', d.deg, 'faceCnt', d.face_cnt, 'areaKm2', d.area_km2, 'poi', (SELECT count(*) FROM poi p WHERE ST_Contains(d.ug, p.geom)) ) ORDER BY d.deg), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT deg, count(*) AS face_cnt, ST_Union(g) AS ug, round((sum(ST_Area(g::geography)) / 1000000)::numeric, 3) AS area_km2 FROM atom GROUP BY deg ) d ),
---------------------------------------------------------------- 每个面各自的量（面板列表用） 'shapes', ( SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object( 'id', v.id, 'name', v.name, 'kind', v.kind, 'areaKm2', round((ST_Area(v.geom::geography) / 1000000)::numeric, 3), 'poi', (SELECT count(*) FROM poi p WHERE ST_Contains(v.geom, p.geom)) ) ORDER BY v.id), '[]'::json) FROM valid v ),
---------------------------------------------------------------- 几何：原子面 + 它的度数 -- ★ properties.deg 让前端按重叠度上色；members 供「2 面重叠是哪两个」的明细 -- ★ SimplifyPreserveTopology 容差约 1.1 m，低于任何缩放级别的视觉分辨率，只减体积不改形状 'geometry', ( SELECT json_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'properties', json_build_object( 'deg', a.deg, 'members', to_json(a.members) ), 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(a.g, 0.00001), 6)::json ) ORDER BY a.deg, ST_Area(a.g::geography) DESC), '[]'::json) ) FROM atom a ),
---------------------------------------------------------------- 设施明细（只在导出时算） -- ★ 平面细分的一大好处：原子面互不重叠，所以每个 POI 恰好落在一个原子里， -- 「这个设施被几层覆盖」是唯一确定的值（deg），不存在算两遍的问题。 -- ★ 默认不算：面板只显示数字，每次拖滑杆都拉几百条 POI 会让响应涨十几倍。 -- 前端只在点「导出 CSV」时传 withItems=true。 -- ★ withItems 必须 cast：CASE 的条件位如果只给占位符， -- PG 推不出参数类型会报 "could not determine data type"。 'items', CASE WHEN cast(#{withItems} as boolean) THEN ( SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object( 'gid', x.gid, 'name', x.name, 'category', x.category, 'lon', x.lon, 'lat', x.lat, 'deg', x.deg, 'members', x.members )), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT p.gid, p.name, p.category, ST_X(p.geom) AS lon, ST_Y(p.geom) AS lat, a.deg, to_json(a.members) AS members FROM poi p JOIN atom a ON ST_Contains(a.g, p.geom) -- 核心区（deg 大）排前面：万一被 limit 截断，重要的不会丢 ORDER BY a.deg DESC, p.gid LIMIT #{itemLimit} ) x ) ELSE '[]'::json END,
-- 明细总数：和返回的 items 长度一比，前端就知道有没有被截断 'itemsTotal', CASE WHEN cast(#{withItems} as boolean) THEN ( SELECT count(*) FROM poi p JOIN atom a ON ST_Contains(a.g, p.geom) ) ELSE 0 END );

WITH params AS ( SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lon}, #{lat}), 4326) AS click, #{budget}::numeric AS budget ),
-- 最近路网节点。两步排序的原因：<-> 在 4326 下按"度"排， -- 经度 1° ≈ 96 km、纬度 1° ≈ 111 km，两者不等价，边界处会选错。 snap AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT c.node_id, c.snap_m FROM ( SELECT v.id AS node_id, ST_Distance(v.geom::geography, p.click::geography) AS snap_m FROM walk_ways_vertices_pgr v, params p ORDER BY v.geom <-> p.click LIMIT 5 ) c ORDER BY c.snap_m LIMIT 1 ),
-- 扣预算：人要先从自己的位置走到路上，剩下的才是路网上还能走多远。 -- GREATEST(...,0) 防负数：点在湖心时 800-1901 是负的， -- 归零后 pgr_drivingDistance 只返回起点自身，被后面的 edge<>-1 过滤掉 → 自然空结果。 used AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT s.node_id, s.snap_m, p.budget, GREATEST(p.budget - s.snap_m, 0) AS used_budget FROM snap s, params p ),
-- 在图上扩散。第 1 参是"图的定义"（text，不能带占位符）： -- id/source/target 是拓扑三列，cost 用 length_m（米）。 -- 第 4 参 false = 无向（步行双向）。 dd AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT node, edge, agg_cost FROM pgr_drivingDistance( 'SELECT id, source, target, length_m AS cost, length_m AS reverse_cost FROM walk_ways', (SELECT node_id FROM used), (SELECT used_budget FROM used), false) WHERE edge <> -1 ),
-- 半截边：预算耗尽时最后那条边只能走一部分。 -- 不补 → 面比真实可达范围小一圈（实测少 27% 面积、4.5 km 路）。 -- ★ ST_LineSubstring 第三参是**比例**不是米；切的方向必须跟着来路： -- 从 source 端走过来切 [0, frac]，从 target 端走过来切 [1-frac, 1]。 partial AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT ST_LineSubstring(w.geom, CASE WHEN w.source = d.node THEN 0 ELSE 1 - LEAST(1, (u.used_budget - d.agg_cost) / NULLIF(w.length_m, 0)) END, CASE WHEN w.source = d.node THEN LEAST(1, (u.used_budget - d.agg_cost) / NULLIF(w.length_m, 0)) ELSE 1 END) AS geom FROM dd d JOIN walk_ways w ON (w.source = d.node OR w.target = d.node) CROSS JOIN used u WHERE u.used_budget > 0 AND d.agg_cost + w.length_m > u.used_budget AND w.id NOT IN (SELECT edge FROM dd) ),
-- 骨架：先 Collect 打包（快），再 LineMerge 焊成连续线（点数减半、体积省一半） skel AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT ST_LineMerge(ST_Collect(ARRAY[ (SELECT ST_Collect(w.geom) FROM dd JOIN walk_ways w ON w.id = dd.edge), (SELECT ST_Collect(geom) FROM partial) ])) AS g ),
-- 面：::geography 让 50 是"地面米"（直接 buffer 会当成 50 度）； -- 先 Simplify 再 buffer 实测省 30%；quad_segs=2 让顶点 999 → 421。 surf AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT ST_MakeValid( ST_Buffer(ST_Simplify(g, 0.00005)::geography, 50, 'quad_segs=2')::geometry ) AS p FROM skel ),
-- 面内设施：全量（统计用）+ 分页（列表用）。 -- ★ 依赖 idx_poi_geom_gist（gist(poi.geom)）；没有它这一步从毫秒变分钟。 pois_all AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT x.gid, x.name, x.category, round(ST_X(x.geom)::numeric, 6) AS lon, round(ST_Y(x.geom)::numeric, 6) AS lat FROM poi x, surf WHERE ST_Within(x.geom, surf.p) ), pois_page AS ( SELECT * FROM pois_all ORDER BY gid LIMIT #{limit} )
SELECT json_build_object( -- 状态：no_network = 最近路网比预算还远（不是"没找到"，是"太远"） 'status', CASE WHEN (SELECT used_budget FROM used) <= 0 THEN 'no_network' ELSE 'ok' END,
-- 透明度三件套：让前端能说清"这个圈以哪儿为圆心、预算剩多少" 'nodeId', (SELECT node_id FROM used), 'snapM', (SELECT round(snap_m) FROM used), 'usedBudgetM', (SELECT round(used_budget) FROM used),
-- 结果 'areaKm2', (SELECT round((ST_Area(p::geography) / 1e6)::numeric, 3) FROM surf), 'surface', (SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Simplify(p, 0.00002), 5)::json FROM surf), 'skeleton', (SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Simplify(g, 0.00002), 5)::json FROM skel), 'edgeCount', (SELECT count(*) FROM dd), 'partialCount', (SELECT count(*) FROM partial), 'walkKm', (SELECT round((sum(w.length_m) / 1000)::numeric, 2) FROM dd JOIN walk_ways w ON w.id = dd.edge),
-- 设施：count/byCategory 用全量，items 分页 'count', (SELECT count(*) FROM pois_all), 'itemsTotal', (SELECT count(*) FROM pois_all), 'byCategory', (SELECT json_build_object( 'school', count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'school'), 'hospital', count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'hospital'), 'mall', count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'mall'), 'park', count(*) FILTER (WHERE category = 'park')) FROM pois_all), 'items', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(pois_page), '[]'::json) FROM pois_page) )::text
